FabFilter Total Bundle.notes: FabFilter only discounts once/year at Black Friday: 25% off. Regular price ~$1176 at PB.

FabFilter Creative Bundle.notes: BF 2024: $269 at PB (lowest recorded). Typical BF/IMSTA sale 25% off = ~$321.

Soundtoys 5.5.notes: Frequent 50% off sales at PB. April 2026 sale was $299 (50% off $599). ATL ~$239 recorded at various retailers. Additional research (2026-07-10): official Soundtoys.com Black Friday 2024 price was $199 (regular was $499 pre-2025 price increase); 2025 summer sale ran $299 (50% off $599) through Aug 5, 2025 — consistent with existing tracked figures.

iZotope Music Production Suite.notes: Regular price $999 (iZotope direct) / $905 at PB. Sale prices 40-50% off. ATL $362 (Aug 2023, Bestservice). Apr 2026: $678 at Gear4music.

NI Komplete 15 Standard.notes: PB regularly runs 50% off NI Komplete (Feb 2025, BF 2025). ATL $266 at Thomann (Nov 2024).

NI Komplete 15 Ultimate.notes: PB runs 50% off during major sales (BF, summer). Typical sale ~50% off = $659.

Arturia V Collection 11.notes: Regular $699-$769. Typical sale 50% off = $349 (BF 2025, PB 14th Anniversary Feb 2026). ATL $295 at Thomann (Nov 2025).

Arturia FX Collection 6.notes: Released Feb 2026. MSRP $499 at Arturia direct / $549 at PB. Arturia typically runs 50% off during BF/summer sales.

Waves Gold Bundle.notes: Waves runs very aggressive flash sales. Regular ~$799-$879 but frequently at $99-$175. ATL $79.99 (Feb 2026 flash sale).

Waves Platinum Bundle.notes: Waves Platinum list price is ~$1999 but almost always on deep sale ($77-$199). PB 14th Anniversary: £99. July 2025: $199. ATL ~$77 (recurring flash sales).

Baby Audio Complete Bundle.notes: 14-plugin bundle (Crystalline, Transit 2, TAIP, Super VHS, Parallel Aggressor, BA-1, Humanoid, etc.), regular $399. Recent 96-hour flash sale at $299 (~25% off) reported via Plugin Alliance listing.

EastWest Composer Cloud+.notes: EastWest ComposerCloud+ subscription (43,000+ instruments). Not sold via Plugin Boutique — direct/Sweetwater/Musician's Friend only. Regular $19.99/mo or $149/yr; frequent first-year promos to ~$99/yr; student-only plans run $49-69/yr.

Output One (Arcade).notes: Output. The standalone Arcade subscription has been folded into Output One ($14.99/mo or $119.99/yr, includes Arcade + Co-Producer + Output FX plugins). Not sold via Plugin Boutique. A Reason+ & Arcade bundle promo briefly offered $149 for the first year, and existing Arcade subscribers have migration/loyalty pricing, but no general public discount is documented for Output One itself.

Waves Mercury Bundle.notes: Waves. Not sold on Plugin Boutique. Nominal/full list price is $7,599 but the actual standing price almost everyone pays is $1,999 (marketed as '74% off'). No confirmed price below $1,999 was found.

Plugin Alliance CORE Subscription.notes: Plugin Alliance. All-access subscription is now branded 'CORE Subscription' ($14.99/mo or $149.99/yr for 200+ plugins); a premium 'Everything Bundle' tier is $29.99/mo or $299.99/yr. The older 'MEGA Bundle' name is no longer used. Not confirmed as sold via Plugin Boutique. No discount/sale data was found in research.

Slate Digital Complete Access.notes: Slate Digital. The former 'All Access Pass' has been folded into 'Complete Access' (Slate Digital + SSL + Harrison), $19.99/mo or $199.99/yr, no long-term commitment. Not sold via Plugin Boutique (only individual perpetual Slate licenses are). A student/faculty rate ($99.99/yr, 50% off) exists but is eligibility-restricted, not a general public sale.

UAD Spark.notes: Universal Audio. UAD Spark subscription, $19.99/mo or $149.99/yr, sold directly via uaudio.com only (not Plugin Boutique). Black Friday deals have cut the annual price to ~$79 ('Save 47%'); a recurring first-year promo of ~$99/yr is also common, plus a 3-months-for-$0.99 new-subscriber intro offer.

FabFilter Pro-Q 4.notes: FabFilter discounts 25% once/year at Black Friday only. ATL $105.25 at Gear4Music (BF Nov 2025). PB BF 2024/2025: 25% off = $149.

FabFilter Pro-C 2.notes: FabFilter discounts 25% at Black Friday only. Typical BF sale ~$97 (25% off $129).

FabFilter Pro-L 2.notes: FabFilter discounts 25% at Black Friday only. Typical BF sale ~$134 (25% off $179).

Kilohearts Phase Plant.notes: PB 14th Anniversary Feb 2026: $119 (40% off). ATL $92 recorded at Plugin Boutique. Kilohearts runs regular 40-50% off sales at PB.

Serum 2.notes: Xfer's official price is $249 (2026). Xfer's founder has stated publicly that Xfer does not run promotions/sales on the perpetual license. Historical intro price $99 (Mar 2025) and a one-off $189 sale (May 2025) are kept below as legacy data points; no recurring sale pattern confirmed.

iZotope Ozone 11 Standard.notes: iZotope runs regular 50% off sales. ATL $70.26 at Best Service (BF Nov 2024). PB BF 2024: also deep discount. Frequent sales throughout year.

iZotope Ozone 11 Advanced.notes: iZotope runs 50% off sales. ATL $141.40 at Best Service (BF Nov 2024). Consider upgrading from Standard instead.

Valhalla Room.notes: Valhalla DSP maintains a fixed $50 price across all retailers and does not offer discounts. Best price you'll ever see IS $50.

Valhalla VintageVerb.notes: Valhalla DSP maintains a fixed $50 price. No discounts ever. Valhalla Supermassive is free (no purchase needed).

Native Instruments Massive X.notes: Regular $199 at NI & Plugin Boutique. Frequently discounted ~50-55%; typical sale $85-$100. ATL $85 recorded at Gear4Music (Sep 19, 2025), $88 at Thomann (Dec 11, 2024), per plugindeals.net price history.

u-he Diva.notes: Regular ~$179 (179 EUR) direct from u-he & Plugin Boutique. Goes on sale a few times/year incl. Black Friday/Cyber Monday (~50% off) and other seasonal retailer promos; reported sale price ~$89 at Sweetwater (anecdotal, not a tracked price-history record).

u-he Repro.notes: Repro-1 + Repro-5 bundle, regular $149 direct from u-he & Plugin Boutique. Periodic retailer discounts; Equipboard reports street prices $79.99-$99. No official published sale calendar found.

Arturia Pigments.notes: Latest version Pigments 7, regular $199 at Arturia & Plugin Boutique. Frequently ~50% off ($99) during version-launch intro sales, Black Friday, and seasonal campaigns. Occasional deeper loyalty pricing (~$69) for existing Arturia customers only, not public sale price.

Spectrasonics Omnisphere.notes: Now Omnisphere 3 (successor to Omnisphere 2), regular $499 new license direct from Spectrasonics. NOT sold on Plugin Boutique — download editions exclusively via Spectrasonics webstore, boxed via authorized resellers. Spectrasonics does not run promotional sales; only fixed upgrade pricing ($199 from prior Omnisphere, $249 from Atmosphere). Minor retailer discounts (~$400-479) exist but are not official sales, so no typical_sale recorded.

reFX Nexus 5.notes: Nexus 5 Starter edition, regular $249 direct from reFX (NOT sold on Plugin Boutique). Runs Black Friday/Christmas sales (~$179-199) and periodic anniversary/bundle promos with expansions at 20-55% off.

LennarDigital Sylenth1.notes: Regular EUR139/~$149 direct from LennarDigital (also monthly subscription ~$9.95/mo). Infrequent, shallow discounts — the only tracked sale in available price-history data was $135 (~10% off) on 2022-10-13, per musicsoftwaredeals.com (dated; may not reflect current sale depth). Not confirmed as sold on Plugin Boutique.

iZotope Ozone 12 Advanced.notes: Ozone 12 Advanced is the current flagship mastering suite (regular $499 direct/NI/PB); Ozone 12 'Standard' tier has been discontinued — the 2026 lineup is Advanced ($499) + Elements ($55) only. Discounted to $366 at Thomann (Mar 20, 2026) per plugindeals.net — lowest recorded 2026 sale. Existing-customer loyalty pricing from $279 also available (NI account required, not a public sale).

iZotope Neutron 5.notes: Full Neutron 5 mixing suite, regular $299 direct from iZotope. Often street-priced lower even outside sales (e.g. $274 Thomann, $222 Music Store). Plugin Boutique periodically runs ~25% off promos on the upgrade SKU specifically ($199 to $149); full-license sale depth not separately confirmed, so all_time_low left null.

FabFilter Pro-R 2.notes: Regular $169 direct from FabFilter (also sold on Plugin Boutique, exact product URL not verified this pass). Like other FabFilter plugins, discounts primarily once/year at Black Friday, ~25-30% off (consistent with the Pro-Q4/Pro-C2/Pro-L2 pattern already tracked) — inferred ~$118-135 sale range; no specific dated Pro-R2 sale price confirmed yet.

oeksound Soothe2.notes: Superseded by Soothe3 ($259 new, $55 upgrade from Soothe 1/2) as of 2026 — oeksound now positions Soothe2 as a legacy product. Soothe2's standard price was ~$199; user/press reports of Black Friday sales to ~$139 (~30% off), e.g. Attack Magazine BF pricing GBP169 to GBP119.

Soundtheory Gullfoss.notes: Regular $199 direct from Soundtheory. Occasional promo-code discounts (~$127-139, e.g. Sound On Sound code SOS30); no confirmed regular/predictable sale calendar — timing appears irregular. Plugin Boutique availability not confirmed from research.

Sonible smart:EQ 4.notes: Regular $129, sold on Plugin Boutique (exact product URL not confirmed this pass). Frequent promos: common sale ~$79 (~40% off); deeper manufacturer-focus sales down to ~$49 (up to 75% off), e.g. Plugin Boutique promo through Mar 31, 2026 per rekkerd.org. Also bundled with smart:comp/smart:limit at an effective ~$50/plugin.

XLN Audio RC-20 Retro Color.notes: Regular $99 at XLN Audio & Plugin Boutique. Frequent deep discounts: $49 (Rekkerd, through Aug 12 2026) and $39 on Plugin Boutique (through Jun 14 2026). One price-tracker listed an outlier low of ~$17.28 (Mar 2023) — excluded here as unconfirmed/likely anomalous.

Baby Audio Crystalline.notes: Algorithmic reverb, regular $99 at Baby Audio & Plugin Boutique. Baby Audio runs frequent site-wide sales (~30-40% off across the catalog) but no Crystalline-specific sale price was confirmed in this research pass.

Output Portal.notes: Granular FX plugin, regular $149 (also via Output One subscription $9.99-14.99/mo, or Splice rent-to-own $9.99/mo x15). Frequent ~50% off sales (~$74.50) at Plugin Boutique/Best Service; deepest recorded ATL $61 at Thomann (Black Friday, Nov 22, 2024) per plugindeals.net.

Native Instruments Kontakt 8.notes: Full sampler, regular $299 at NI & Plugin Boutique. No confirmed official sale calendar for the full standard license found in this pass; a crossgrade/upgrade path (~$149, eligibility-restricted) exists but is not equivalent to a public discount on the full license, so no typical_sale recorded.

Vital.notes: Basic tier is fully free with the complete synth engine (all features), ~75 presets/25 wavetables. Paid Plus (~$25) and Pro (~$80) tiers only add more bundled presets/wavetables/content — same engine, not a 'sale'. Sold direct from vital.audio only; no evidence of Plugin Boutique distribution or recurring discount sales.

u-he Hive 2.notes: u-he. Regular promo ~30% off ($104). Documented Black Friday low of $65 in 2022 and 2023 (Reddit r/AudioProductionDeals tracking thread); missed the BF sale in 2024.

u-he Bazille.notes: u-he. Typical PB promo ~30% off (~$90). Deeper direct-from-u-he Autumn Sale 2025 hit 50% off (€64.50), Nov 18–Dec 3 2025.

Synapse Audio Dune 3.notes: Developer is Synapse Audio (not Xfer Records). Not documented as sold on Plugin Boutique. Group/coupon deals have hit $74.76; a $99 Thomann price is described as the closest to typical Black-Friday-level pricing.

Vengeance Sound Avenger 2.notes: Vengeance Sound. Black Friday promo documented at 33% off ($150.75). A $98 low was reported at Thomann on Jan 6, 2025 (plugindeals.net) but is treated as an unconfirmed outlier and not used as the all-time low.

KV331 Audio SynthMaster 3.notes: KV331 Audio. Winter sale $49 (~50% off); Summer Sale $59 (~40% off). No source explicitly labels either price as an all-time low.

Reveal Sound Spire.notes: Reveal Sound. Recurring flash sales to $75–$76 (~60% off); documented low $66 at Best Service on May 16, 2026 (and previously Dec 20, 2025). Reddit users cite a usual sale price around $100.

Native Instruments Massive.notes: NI's original/classic Massive (not Massive X) — still sold, not discontinued. Nov 2025 Plugin Boutique promo gave it away free with any purchase rather than a cash discount, so no reliable typical sale price is documented.

GForce OB-E.notes: GForce Software. Not documented as sold on Plugin Boutique. Current promo price $119 (~30% off $169.99) appears to be the standing price at both GForce direct and Sweetwater; no dated Black Friday figure or confirmed all-time low was found.

Cherry Audio GX-80.notes: Cherry Audio. Blockbuster Sale price $39 (44% off) matched at Plugin Boutique (43% off until Jun 1); no source shows a lower documented promo price.

Tokyo Dawn Labs TDR Nova GE.notes: Tokyo Dawn Labs. Frequently discounted at Plugin Boutique to ~$19 (68% off); direct Summer Sale price €39 (35% off). Documented lowest-ever price $14 at AudioDeluxe on Jul 4, 2024 (plugindeals.net).

DMG Audio EQuilibrium.notes: DMG Audio, sold direct only (not on Plugin Boutique). A third-party aggregator (pluginplug.io) shows $130 and $100 price points with no clear dates, so these are not counted as a confirmed sale or low.

Waves SSL E-Channel.notes: Waves. Not currently sold on Plugin Boutique (historical PB listing only). Effectively in a near-permanent sale at $34.99 (77% off $149 MSRP); reseller PluginDiscounts cited $31.46 as a documented low, though the exact date wasn't specified in the source.

Sonnox Oxford EQ.notes: Sonnox. HDX/HD version historically sold via Plugin Boutique (regular ~$474); native plugin lists direct at £239.99 with a 75% off Summer Sale to £59.99. Lowest recorded PB price $47 on Jul 14, 2025 (plugindeals.net).

Klanghelm MJUC.notes: Klanghelm, sold direct only (not on Plugin Boutique). Stable everyday-low price (~€24); MJUC jr is free. No documented sales or Black Friday discounts — an old ~€23-24 intro price from launch is essentially unchanged from today's price.

Klanghelm DC8C mkII.notes: Klanghelm, sold direct only (not on Plugin Boutique). No sales/Black Friday discounting documented; price has only crept up slowly over time (~€20 circa 2014 to ~€23-24 today) rather than via time-limited markdowns.

Wavesfactory Trackspacer.notes: Wavesfactory. Moderate promos to $36 (38% off); deeper sales recur at $29 (~51% off), most recently documented Dec 8, 2025 at Plugin Boutique (musicsoftwaredeals.com).

Waves CLA-2A.notes: Waves. Sold individually on Plugin Boutique. Full non-sale list is typically $149-199; also bundled in the $89.99 CLA Classic Compressors bundle, which itself drops to $29.99-$49.99 on sale.

Waves CLA-76.notes: Waves. Sold individually on Plugin Boutique alongside CLA-2A (same 2026 Band Month promo, $29.99 / 79% off); the exact PB product-page ID wasn't confirmed in research, so a PB search link is used instead of guessing the ID.

UAD 1176 Classic Limiter Collection.notes: Universal Audio. Available as a perpetual purchase (not subscription-only) via uaudio.com and resellers including Plugin Boutique. Common sale price $49 (67% off); documented low $29 at Plugin Boutique on May 3, 2025 (plugindeals.net).

LiquidSonics Cinematic Rooms MKII.notes: LiquidSonics. Not sold on Plugin Boutique — direct only. Standard $199 / Professional $399. Launch intro pricing was ~35% off; bundles see 12-37% off, and a Black-Friday 'Ultimate Bundle' reportedly hit ~63% off across multiple products, but no single-product all-time low is confirmed.

Eventide Blackhole.notes: Eventide. Sold on both Eventide's own store and Plugin Boutique at $99. Frequent promos to $39-$49; a coupon-driven deal reached $29 (87% off), but plugindeals.net's price-history tracker documents an earlier, lower $24.90 at Thomann on Nov 29, 2022.

Relab Development LX480 Complete.notes: Relab Development. Sold via Plugin Boutique among other resellers (Dual-Engine Reverb V4 = the 'Complete' tier). Band Month sale price $149 (57% off $349). The cut-down Essentials tier ($99 reg.) separately hits $29 (70% off), but that figure doesn't apply to the Complete/Dual-Engine version.

Softube Tape.notes: Softube. Sold on Plugin Boutique at $99. Single-plugin sales typically ~$79-$89.99 (10-20% off); the Softube Producers Collection bundle ($139 for 13 plugins) was separately called 'lowest price ever' for that bundle, not for standalone Tape.

Wavesfactory Cassette.notes: Wavesfactory. Sold on Plugin Boutique at the standard $59 price; no reliable sale, discount percentage, or Black Friday pricing was found in research as of mid-2026.

u-he Satin.notes: u-he. Recurring promo to $89-$90 (~30-31% off $129). A third-party aggregator (Equipboard) lists prices as low as $39, but with no dated primary source, so it isn't counted as a confirmed all-time low.

Baby Audio TAIP.notes: Baby Audio. Sold on Plugin Boutique at $99. A YouTube review referenced a ~90%-off sale down to about $9.99, but this is a single anecdotal/YouTube-sourced reference with no confirmed date, so it is not used as a tracked sale or all-time-low figure.

iZotope Ozone Elements.notes: iZotope Ozone 12 Elements. Sold on Plugin Boutique per MusicTech coverage of a 'lowest price ever' PB promotion on Mar 19, 2026 (no exact PB product URL confirmed in research). iZotope's own Summer Sale (Jun 2026) separately offered Elements-tier plugins at $25 each.

Sonnox Oxford Limiter.notes: Sonnox. Sold direct; historically also available via Plugin Boutique through the 'Producer Power Bundle' (lowest recorded bundle price $49). Direct Summer Sale price £57.49 (75% off £229.99, converted here to ~$290/$72). A YouTube review mentions a $29 Black Friday 2024 price, but that single unconfirmed source isn't used as an all-time low.

DMG Audio Limitless.notes: DMG Audio, direct-sale only (not on Plugin Boutique). No documented sales or discounting pattern beyond DMG's general policy of discounting brand-new releases for their first month.

Newfangled Audio Elevate.notes: Newfangled Audio/Eventide. Not sold on Plugin Boutique. Elevate Mastering Bundle regularly discounted to $79 (~60% off $199 list). A ~$39.50 price was mentioned anecdotally in a Reddit comment but is unconfirmed and not used as an all-time low.

Spitfire Audio BBC Symphony Orchestra Pr.notes: Spitfire Audio. Not sold on Plugin Boutique — direct/Thomann only. Core tier $449, Discover tier free. Seasonal sales (incl. Black Friday) typically 30-40% off ($649-$699); documented all-time low $549 (Jan 8, 2022, musicsoftwaredeals.com). More recent 2025 Thomann lows of $582-$666 are shallower than this 2022 figure.

Spectrasonics Keyscape.notes: Spectrasonics. Not sold on Plugin Boutique — direct/authorized-dealer network only (AudioDeluxe, PluginFox, Best Service, etc). Spectrasonics avoids large seasonal discounts; documented lowest price $379 (~5% off $399) at AudioDeluxe on Jun 27, 2024 (plugindeals.net), unusually shallow for the plugin market.

UVI Falcon 3.notes: UVI (Falcon 2026 release). Sold on Plugin Boutique. Late-Oct/early-Nov 2025 intro and 'Synth Month' promos consistently priced Falcon 3 at $149 (50% off $299) across UVI direct, Plugin Boutique, and Reddit deal threads — no source shows anything lower.

XLN Audio Addictive Keys.notes: XLN Audio. Addictive Keys is sold as individual instruments (e.g. Studio Grand, priced here) as well as a $249 Complete Collection direct from XLN. Plugin Boutique promo documented at $59.40 (40% off $99); no dated all-time-low record was found.

Toontrack EZdrummer 3.notes: Toontrack. Not confirmed as sold on Plugin Boutique. Standard $179, with a recurring 25% off promo to $134 (Thomann shows $122, a deeper ~32% off). No documented Black Friday-specific figure or all-time low was found.

Toontrack Superior Drummer 3.notes: Toontrack. Not confirmed as sold on Plugin Boutique. Regular $399, standard sale $299 (25% off) — a forum user calls this one of the best prices ever seen since SD3 rarely discounts. A $251.26 price using a stacked BestService coupon code appears in a single forum post but is treated as an unconfirmed one-off, not a tracked all-time low.

GetGood Drums Modern & Massive 2.notes: GetGood Drums. Not confirmed sold on Plugin Boutique (direct-from-GGD only in available data). Regular price $219; no dated sale, Black Friday percentage, or all-time-low figures were found despite GGD being known generally to run seasonal sales.

Antares Auto-Tune Pro.notes: Antares. Auto-Tune Pro 11 lists at $450-$500 depending on source; Spring 2026 flash sale cut it to $250 (50% off). Plugin Boutique is a confirmed Antares reseller, though the $150/72%-off low documented Nov 25, 2025 was for the separate, cheaper 'Auto-Tune 2026' tier, not Pro.

Celemony Melodyne 5 Studio.notes: Celemony. Not sold on Plugin Boutique (only upgrades/updates appear at third-party shops). $699 web-shop price is a permanent 17% markdown off the $849 MSRP, not a limited sale. Deep discounts (e.g. 80% off) apply only to version-upgrade paths, not new full licenses.

iZotope Nectar 4.notes: iZotope. Sold on Plugin Boutique. Prices shown are for the Standard tier ($199 reg., $149.25 current promo); the Advanced tier is $299 regular. The $129 all-time low (57% off, Aug 17, 2025, plugindeals.net) is documented specifically for the Advanced tier at Plugin Boutique, not Standard.

Waves Tune Real-Time.notes: Waves. Not confirmed as sold on Plugin Boutique (no PB listing found in research). Effectively in a near-permanent sale at $49.99 (75% off $199 MSRP); related Waves Tune LT drops to $34.99 (65% off $99).

Baby Audio Spaced Out.notes: Baby Audio. Substituted for the non-existent 'Baby Audio Parametric'. Regular price $99 one-time. A follow-up query to confirm Plugin Boutique listing and sale history failed (Perplexity API quota error), so PB status and sale pricing are unconfirmed — treat this entry as provisional until re-researched.
